subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt or port https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Channels page resolver fix, or request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The issue remains valid, but an open cross-repository PR already has closing syntax and a focused patch, so a new automated fix would duplicate the existing implementation path unless maintainers decide to replace it.

options.title: Adopt or port the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as the implementation source, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` path and refreshing proof as needed.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Leave the cross-repository PR aside and ask for a current-main UI-only PR with focused tests and browser or terminal proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt or port the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as the implementation source, porting it to the current `ui/src/pages/channels/view.ts` path and refreshing proof as needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI architecture history makes this the closest current routing owner for deciding whether to port the stale-path candidate or request a replacement.
